value.name: Claire returns to the kitchen door
value.description: Claire's footsteps move back toward the kitchen door after the phone call shifts away from her.
evidence: Claire's footsteps started back toward the kitchen door.

value.name: Marcus takes the phone
value.description: The phone is passed to Marcus, who comes onto the line already composed for Claire's reaction.
evidence: The phone changed hands on the other end with the small fumble of a receiver passed without a word, and then Marcus was there, his breathing already adjusted to whatever face Claire had carried back into the kitchen.

value.name: Asha confronts Marcus about the papers
value.description: Asha coldly demands an explanation for why Marcus has kept the papers for nine days.
evidence: she said, cold and precise, "Marcus, explain why you've held onto those papers for nine days."

value.name: Marcus realizes Claire revealed the papers
value.description: Marcus understands that Claire told Asha about the papers and that Asha knows he has been hiding them.
evidence: The number landed before he could place where she had gotten it; she heard the half-second in which he understood that Claire had been the one to hand it to her

value.name: Asha withholds sympathy
value.description: Asha refuses to soften her accusation and lets Marcus face the consequences in silence.
evidence: she did not move to soften what that meant for the kitchen he was standing in.

value.name: Marcus starts to excuse himself
value.description: Marcus begins to respond with a hesitant explanation about timing but does not complete it.
evidence: Asha did not answer the first thing Marcus tried, which was a half-breath that wanted to become a sentence about timing.
